label: neutral-production-baseline-2026-11-27
disclaimer: neutral-workload measurements of real Nirnay components; not a production latency/throughput certificate, not nanosecond/HFT, not horizontal scale; no resource maxima are set
scope: Real production functions driven by opaque byte payloads and monotonic u64 sequence values; no instruments, quotes, books, prices, trades, invented market observations, provider, broker or live-execution path. Fixed API scaffolding has no measurement meaning.
stage_separation: one stage timer wraps one production API call; unmeasured fenced prerequisite calls prepare isolated stages; pipeline_total wraps the whole per-event sequence; replay_recovery has one replay observation per repetition; elapsed_ns is the sum of target-call samples
quantile_method: nearest-rank: sort ascending, index = round((n-1)*fraction); count_beyond_X counts strictly greater samples; raw_histogram_ns is lossless
source_sha_scope: commit containing the benchmark source at measurement time; a file cannot contain the SHA of the commit that contains it, so the later artifact-only commit is not self-bound
build_profile: bench profile inherits release (lto=thin, codegen-units=1, panic=abort)
